fusions.name: Reef Rash
fusions.desc: A scraping weapon strike that deals 4 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Seeding Shard
fusions.desc: Hurls a shard of reef that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets. Every affliction you have on that enemy spreads to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Wreckers' Shoal
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Accretion
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
